setup.datasetTitle: What should we start you with?
setup.companyLead: Three questions, so the product arrives set up rather than blank. You can change any of it later.
setup.datasetLead: Whichever you pick, every feature is switched on. This is only about what is in it on day one.
setup.failed: The last attempt stopped: {detail}. Your answers are still here — try again.

size.label: How many people will use it?

country.label: Where is the company based?
country.hintFor: Sets your time zone to {timezone}, starts the week on {weekday, select, MONDAY {Monday} TUESDAY {Tuesday} WEDNESDAY {Wednesday} THURSDAY {Thursday} FRIDAY {Friday} SATURDAY {Saturday} SUNDAY {Sunday} other {the first working day}}, and builds that country's public holiday calendar.
country.hint: Sets your time zone and working week, and builds that country's public holiday calendar.

sample.title: Example company
sample.body: Offices, departments, job titles, leave policies and a set of people sized to your answer — enough to see how every screen looks before you put anything real in.

empty.title: Start empty
empty.body: Nothing but your own account. Everything is here — the fields, the roles, the leave types — and none of it is filled in with anybody imaginary.

full.title: Full demo
full.body: The complete demo company: fifty people whatever your size, with every feature exercised. The most to look at, and the most to clear out afterwards.

building.title: Setting up your company
building.lead: This takes a few moments. You can leave this page — it will pick up where it left off.

steps.localization: Setting your time zone and working week

language.label: Language
language.hint: Everybody in the company sees noddo in it — screens, emails and exports. You can change it later in Settings.

avatar.qrAlt: Scan to upload a photo from your phone
avatar.qrHint: Scan it with your phone's camera. The code works once, for the next few minutes.

mobileAvatar.title: Add your photo
mobileAvatar.lead: Take a photo for your profile.
mobileAvatar.failed: That did not work. Ask for a new code and try again.

done.title: That's your photo
done.body: It is already on your profile. You can close this page and go back to your computer.

expired.title: This code has expired
expired.body: Codes last a few minutes and work once. Show a new one on your computer and scan it again.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.hint: When something happened is shown in this zone. Dates in the calendar sense — a hire date, a day of leave — are the same day for everybody and do not move.

welcome.preferencesTitle: How would you like things shown?
welcome.leadWithFields: A photo so colleagues can put a face to your name, and anything of yours that is still blank.
welcome.leadPhotoOnly: A photo, so colleagues can put a face to your name.
welcome.preferencesLead: Two settings, and you can change them whenever you like.
welcome.nothingToFill: Everything else about you lives on your profile, where you can change it any time.
